headline.h: The frontier moved to the desk, the glasses store, and a Qatari decree.
headline.b: Meta's 816B Muse Spark Open runs on two Mac Studios, Alibaba's Qwen N1 undercuts Ray-Ban at $450, and Qatar's new National Center for AI makes the GCC a three-capital market.

whats_next.verdict: Gulf creator economy hit 263K monetizing (+75%); UGC is the one asset Muse-for-SMB can't replicate at brand tier.
whats_next.arlab_play: Reposition AI UGC and Creator Content as always-on monthly retainers tied to NatDay-to-GITEX pipeline.

whats_next.verdict: Krea 3 at $0.06/edit and Kling 4.0's 30-second shots turn live imagery into a utility — not a line item.
whats_next.arlab_play: Rebuild the AI at Scale stack on Krea 3 + Kling 4.0 + Nano Banana Pro; retire Sora pipelines before Q4 bids.

whats_next.verdict: Qwen N1 at $450, Ray-Ban Gen 3 shipping, Rokid self-service stores open — four stacks, no winner, GCC still unbuyable on Snap and Meta Display.
whats_next.arlab_play: Spec dual-rail Snapchat Lens + WebAR demos that run on Qwen N1 and Meta glass for GITEX Dec 7–11.

whats_next.verdict: DSS 2026 closed +110% avg spend; KSA converts live at 8–15% while TikTok Shop UAE stays unconfirmed into Q4.
whats_next.arlab_play: Sell Live Shopping Activation as a monthly agentic retainer wired through Snap Ads MCP per-agent OAuth.

whats_next.verdict: Qatar decreed a National Center for AI Oct 20; HUMAIN runs dual-silicon; the Gulf is now three capitals, three stacks.
whats_next.arlab_play: Open a Doha channel before Milipol closes; pitch AI Consultative Solutions on humain-m3 and Core42 lanes.

whats_next.verdict: DeepSeek silently swapped V4.1-Flash into prod; Sakana MASS collapses crews to one model; pin versions or ship broken.
whats_next.arlab_play: Sell Agentic Pipelines as metered running systems with model-pin + drift-test clauses in every SOW.

dates_to_watch.what: Milipol Qatar + Doha AI & Security Summit
dates_to_watch.why_it_matters: First live showcase since the Qatar National Center for AI was decreed — the window to plant ARlab's flag in the third GCC capital before Riyadh and Abu Dhabi agencies arrive.

dates_to_watch.what: FII10 Riyadh + Dubai AI Festival (overlapping Oct 26–27)
dates_to_watch.why_it_matters: Every sovereign cheque and ministry buyer stacks in a single 72-hour window across two capitals — presence in both sets the Q1 2027 procurement narrative.
Largest European open-weight ever — gives GCC pitches a sovereign-safe non-Chinese, non-US frontier option alongside Muse Spark Open and humain-m3.

dates_to_watch.what: Blender 5.3 stable with native Gaussian splats + SPZ v4
dates_to_watch.why_it_matters: Splat plugin era ends overnight — ARlab's WebAR, 3D Virtual Stores and Interactive Screens pipelines need to be ported before competitors catch up.

dates_to_watch.what: GITEX Global at Expo City Dubai
dates_to_watch.why_it_matters: 200K+ attendees, last enterprise pitching window before Q1 budgets close — anchor event for post-NatDay retainers across Digital Installations, Live Shopping, and Agentic Pipelines.
